# Context Management Rule

Shared memory is the session source of truth.

## Required Shared Files

- `.github/context/session-memory.md`
- `.github/context/repo-profile.md`
- `.github/context/contract.md`
- `.github/context/decision-log.md`
- `.github/context/progress.md`

## Update Cadence

Update shared memory after each significant milestone:

- completed work
- decisions and rationale
- assumptions and constraints
- pending work
- test and review outcomes
- unresolved risks

## Consumption Rule

Before starting work, each agent reads relevant shared memory files.
